**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

Section 8 satisfies the RENEWAL rule at the **preferred** position on every material term:

- **Renewal term** — successive twelve-month periods (§8.2), not multi-year.
- **Notice window** — Customer opt-out on just **30 days'** written notice, well inside the preferred ≤30 days.
- **Vendor reminder** — required **60 days** before renewal, with the opt-out deadline extended to 30 days after a late reminder is received (a Customer-favourable enhancement).
- **Price uplift** — capped at the **lesser of CPI and 3%** (§8.3), with 90 days' notice and no increase applied to prepaid periods.

No conflicting uplift or renewal language appears elsewhere (the only "increase" references in the document are in §8.3).
